name: Chillever Personalized Embroidered Nurse Sweatshirt
metaDescription: A personalized embroidered nurse sweatshirt with a custom name and specialty like ER, RN, NP, or L&D. A cozy, thoughtful gift for nurses on cold shifts.
summary: A cozy sweatshirt embroidered with the nurse's name and specialty, a personal gift that celebrates their role, whether ER, L&D, RN, or NP.
whyItWorks: Hospitals are famously cold, and many nurses keep a warm layer in their locker for long shifts and drafty break rooms. A sweatshirt embroidered with their own name and specialty turns that everyday layer into something they feel proud to wear, at work where allowed, on the drive home, or around the house on days off.

Personalization is what sets this gift apart. Nurses identify strongly with their specialty, and seeing ER, L&D, RN, or NP stitched alongside their name recognizes the path they chose and the training it took. That makes it a great gift for a new grad who just landed a job in labor and delivery, a nurse who passed a certification, or an NP finishing school. Embroidery also gives it a more polished, lasting look than a printed design. Because it is made to order, give yourself extra time before a birthday or the holidays so it arrives when you need it.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for the full list of specialty options and how to enter the custom name.
Review the size chart before ordering, since personalized items are often hard to return.
Allow extra shipping time for custom embroidery, especially around holidays.

faq.q: Can nurses wear this sweatshirt at work?
faq.a: Some units allow a warm layer over scrubs and others require specific jackets. It is always great for commuting and days off either way.
